description: MySQL is a program for storing and finding data in tables. A table is like a sheet with named columns and rows. Learn to ask questions with SQL, then add and change practice data. Later lessons cover links between tables, totals and backups. Run these examples with MySQL on your computer; this site uses SQLite only for its browser SQL playground.
versionNote: Targets MySQL 8.4 LTS and 9.x. Examples show the output of the mysql command-line client; the site playground runs SQLite, so these snippets are not runnable here.
whatYouWillLearn: Read information from a table with SQL
Make a backup and control access
learningObjectives: Explain what MySQL and SQL do
Ask MySQL to show text and do maths
Tell a database table from a spreadsheet picture

seo.title: MySQL Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn MySQL with simple tables, queries, filters, joins and data changes. Follow the worked examples and use the reference when you need a reminder.
